title: New Term Reduction on Added Residential Gas Premises — Residential Natural Gas Supply
content:
**Offer term.** For a premise added to a Residential Natural Gas Supply household, the new commitment reduction depends on the home agreement's most recent plan change date and term: 0.0040 per therm when that date is no more than 30 calendar days before the enrollment date and the term is 24 months or more, 0.0020 per therm when that date is no more than 30 calendar days before the enrollment date and the term is above zero but below 24 months, and none in every other case. The reduction lowers the household rate by that amount per therm.

The records read are the plan change date and the term in months on the home agreement.

| Home agreement's plan change date | Home agreement's term | Reduction per therm |
|---|---|---|
| no more than 30 days before the enrollment date | 24 months or more | 0.0040 |
| no more than 30 days before the enrollment date | 1 to 23 months | 0.0020 |
| no more than 30 days before the enrollment date | 0 months | none |
| more than 30 days before the enrollment date | any | none |
| none recorded | any | none |

### Cases (hypothetical; enrollment date 20 June)

- Plan change date 21 May (30 days before), term 36 months: 0.0040.
- Plan change date 21 May, term 12 months: 0.0020.
- Plan change date 20 May (31 days before), term 36 months: none.
